items.name: activity.marker
items.why: Observed/inferred marker has no field name or wire type; confidence/interval constraints incomplete.
items.decision: Approve exact marker name/enum, signal types and interval/confidence semantics; Activity stays false.
items.resolutionDetail: activityMarker enum observed|inferred; closed signalTypes allowlist still|walking|running|cycling|driving|transit|unknown; interval {start,end} with end>=start; confidence 0..1. Activity capability stays false.

items.name: email.addresses
items.why: Address shape (string or structured) and validation are unspecified.
items.decision: Approve sender and recipient DTOs; Email sender remains false.
items.resolutionDetail: Structured {address, displayName?} with format email and maxLength 320 for address, maxLength 256 for displayName. Email capability stays false.

items.name: attachmentRefs.items
items.why: Attachment reference DTO and authorization/expiry are unspecified.
items.decision: Approve exact attachment reference DTO and lifecycle; only empty lists currently accepted.
items.resolutionDetail: Opaque {refId, provider?, mimeType?, sizeBytes?, sha256?, expiresAt?} DTO remains documented, but both attachmentRefs arrays are empty-only (maxItems: 0) until a connector is approved; no credentialed URLs. Non-empty arrays are rejected.

items.name: error.details
items.why: Field paths/limits/versions described without keys or types.
items.decision: Approve strict detail variants; optional details currently forbidden.
items.resolutionDetail: Strict discriminated union by kind: field_errors[] (field/code/expected/actual), retry(retryAfterSeconds), conflict(conflictId), blocked_category(blockedCategory). No free-form details object.

items.name: receipt.processing
items.why: Only queued appears in normative receipt; later processing values unspecified.
items.decision: Confirm queued-only durable receipts or enumerate other receipt states.
items.resolutionDetail: Durable receipts are queued-only in v2.0.0; later states require a versioned contract revision.

items.name: capabilities.auth
items.why: All routes require owner/scope, while table says No credentials.
items.decision: Confirm bearer-protected response contains no credentials (bundle interpretation) or approve public access.
items.resolutionDetail: GET /api/v2/capabilities is bearer-protected; response contains no credentials, only booleans, limits and registry version.

items.name: capabilities.featureGates
items.why: No location/activity/connector/episode advertisement fields exist.
items.decision: Approve feature advertisement fields before enabling any of these captures/features.
items.resolutionDetail: features {email, activity, location, episodes, connectors} are booleans fixed false in this revision; observationRevisions and decimalFinance remain true. A gate may only be advertised after its evidence exists.

items.name: timestamp.presence
items.why: Required-fields paragraph says nullable; data model mentions absent optional canonicalized to null.
items.decision: Confirm both fields required on wire and null represents unknown (bundle interpretation).
items.resolutionDetail: sourceOccurredAt and sourceUpdatedAt are required nullable wire fields; null means unknown, never now.

items.name: raw.security
items.why: Explicit extension object permits arbitrary names, but credential prohibition has no complete portable key allowlist.
items.decision: Approve source-specific raw allowlists and privacy limits; schema success alone cannot authorize raw payloads.
items.resolutionDetail: raw allowlists: notification {packageName,title,body}; receipt/wallet {amount,currency,merchant,transactionType}. note/email/activity/location raw must be empty. Unknown or credential-shaped keys are rejected; raw payloads remain source-policy gated.

items.name: batch.minimumAndMalformedIdentity
items.why: Maximum given but empty batch semantics and per-item deliveryId for malformed/missing UUID unspecified.
items.decision: Confirm nonempty batches (subset restriction) and specify unidentified-item error behavior.
items.resolutionDetail: Batches are non-empty 1..100. Each result carries input index 0..99. Malformed items return deliveryId null plus a per-item error; valid items still process.

items.name: decimal.storageAndFX
items.why: Wire permits 6 decimals without integer digit limit; storage NUMERIC(24,6), FX NUMERIC(24,12).
items.decision: Approve magnitude/digit bounds and separate FX precision DTO; subset rejects rates beyond 6 fractional digits.
items.resolutionDetail: Amounts are decimal strings with at most 18 integer and 6 fractional digits. Conversion.rate uses ConversionRate with at most 12 fractional digits. Storage NUMERIC(24,6)/NUMERIC(24,12).

items.name: currency.registry
items.why: ISO registry version, unsupported ISO handling and conversion rounding DTO not pinned.
items.decision: Pin currency registry, exponents and rounding rule; only UYU/USD confirmed summary fixture semantics tested.
items.resolutionDetail: Currency is a 3-letter ISO 4217 code; capabilities advertises currencyRegistryVersion ISO4217-CLDR-45; round half-even to the CLDR exponent; unsupported codes return unsupported_currency. Only UYU/USD summary fixtures are confirmed.

items.name: deletion.creationResponse
items.why: Deletion ID/state names described but full creation response absent.
items.decision: Approve exact 202 response; operation remains excluded.
items.resolutionDetail: 202 {deletionId, state:"queued", createdAt, remainingCategories:[]}; the deletion worker and the POST operation itself remain excluded from this revision.

items.name: deletion.remainingCategories
items.why: Category enum and blockedAt meaning/nullability unspecified.
items.decision: Approve category allowlist and timestamp semantics; schema is structural only.
items.resolutionDetail: Category allowlist raw_events, derived_knowledge, embeddings, financial_records, connectors, backups. blockedAt is a required nullable UTC timestamp meaning waiting on the named category.

items.name: Fact
items.why: uncertainty candidates/value variants, field allowlist, pointer/excerpt hashing and entity reference shape incomplete.
items.decision: Approve discriminated Fact schema including UTF-16 span and evidence checks; no generic value placeholder.
items.resolutionDetail: Fact is a strict discriminated union on factType (string|decimal|currency|timestamp|boolean|entity_ref) with typed value, UTF-16 start/end spans that must be paired, excerptHash, confidence 0..1, extractorVersion and visibility through validationStatus/userCorrectionStatus. Evidence must reference an existing event; no generic placeholder value.

items.name: enrollmentAndRetention
items.where: Out-of-band admin device/source issuance and PRD retention defaults
items.why: No public enrollment/rotation/logout wire flow approved; retention defaults require privacy owner approval.
items.decision: Approve admin issuance/revocation ownership, source/device lifecycle, explicit empty-selection consent and dated retention decisions.
items.resolutionDetail: Device-to-owner credential registry for first release; owner-controlled audited admin issuance/revocation; no public enrollment API; explicit selection with empty selection capturing nothing. Retention defaults remain as recorded in the G1 ledger and do not create wire fields in this revision.

items.name: summary.filters
items.why: conversionTo/fxRateId pairing specified, but time bounds/defaults and allowed conversion currencies incomplete.
items.decision: Approve required time range, bound ordering and currency/rate registry; subset requires from/to.
items.resolutionDetail: from and to are required, from<=to, max range 366 days; conversion requires fxRateId; currency must be in the approved registry (confirmed UYU/USD subset); no defaults. Encoded by FinancialSummaryQuery and summary query fixtures.

intentionallyExcludedOperations.reason: Destructive deletion creation remains excluded from OpenAPI and mobile implementation until a deletion worker and separate owner approval exist. Its response DTO is published for future structural review.

rule: Resolved decisions are encoded, not approved. Provisional operation schemas authorise no implementation until contracts:verify and independent review complete.
